description: Calibrated 2017 EHT visibility and closure measurements contain horizon-scale structure from the compact radio source at the center of M87; image-domain ring morphology is a downstream reconstruction, not a direct detector frame.

uncertainty.description: The official EHT Git release pinned to commit 27ae76aacb9067a83388395c3826012b97aac371 was ingested and hashed by Vajra. Scientific calibration claims and byte-for-byte equivalence with the CyVerse DOI endpoint remain to be independently reproduced.
